Fictionalco Reports Second Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results

TESTVILLE, Aug. 4, 2026 -- Fictionalco Group, a made-up company used only in tests, today announced results.

Revenue was $8.0 billion for the quarter, compared with $7.5 billion in the prior-year quarter.

Outlook: for fiscal 2026, Fictionalco expects diluted earnings-per-share of $14.50 to $14.80.
